label: training-gym-r55-complete
context:
Training Gym R55 completed! ALL 4 CLEAN ON FIRST TRY!

R55 RESULTS (all 10/10, all clean):
1. sparse-table-001 (T7) - Sparse Table for O(1) RMQ. table[k][i] = min of arr[i..i+2^k-1]. O(n log n) build, O(1) query.
2. binary-heap-001 (T6) - Binary min-heap from scratch. Array repr, sift_up/sift_down, O(n) heapify.
3. weighted-union-find-001 (T8) - Weighted UF with diff[] tracking. Path compression accumulates diffs. Union maintains weight(x,y)=w invariant.
4. knapsack-001 (T6) - 0/1 Knapsack DP. O(W) 1D optimization for value-only. 2D for item tracing.

DB: 270 exercises, 459 attempts, avg 9.88, 94.3% perfect. 207 passed.
21+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.

Key learning: Weighted UF is the hardest — diff[x] tracks weight from x to parent[x], path compression must accumulate diffs, union must solve the offset equation so that diff_x - diff_y = w in the merged tree.
decisions: Sparse table: K = floor(log2(n)), table[k][i] = min(table[k-1][i], table[k-1][i+2^(k-1)])
Heap: heapify from last non-leaf (n//2-1) down, sift_down each
Weighted UF: diff[x] = weight from x to parent[x]. find accumulates diff. union solves offset equation.
Knapsack: iterate w backwards (capacity to weights[i]) for 1D. Trace back with 2D: if dp[i][w]!=dp[i-1][w] then item included
next_steps: Design R56 exercises. Try: AVL tree, Red-Black tree, B-tree, skip list, or interval tree.
